misprints.note: Trumpna: the print has ο for υ.
Trumpetsignal: no grave accent is printed on ἀπο.
Tråd: the genitive is printed as νός, without the initial ἰ.

uncertain.note: Because of the η's descender, I can't tell whether there is an iota subscript. I kept τῇ.
The breathing on ἴς is small and could be either smooth or rough. I read it as smooth.
The print breaks it across lines as 'gm-gångar'. I joined it as an ordinary line-end hyphen.
